notes.title: New Trailer and Release Date
notes.notes: I would like to inform you that the game has an exact release date - July 13, 2024. There is also a new short trailer of the game on the page. Thank you for your attention!

notes.title: Update #4
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42039565/5ddb0119d6e10423cd52d6a0ecc31bbde8c351ba.png
The updated demo is ready and waiting in the wings!

 Added Italian language
 Menu tabs for easier navigation
 Added a separate hero volume slider
 The color scheme has changed
 A list of tasks appeared in the form of a notepad in your hands
 The ring is used on a separate button
 A kerosene lamp may go out randomly
 Almost all known bugs have been fixed

notes.title: Update #3
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42039565/deda72622f0217683a7b1ecf00a1da20d610873d.png
Big demo update.
Added:
- Simplified Chinese
- Spanish
- German
- Turkish language
- Fixed English language
Bugs:
- Items and triggers after painting do not reappear
- Pause now works on Esc
- Game volume can be increased
- Fixed collision of some items
- Fixed a bug with the player's body during the inspection of items
- Items in the box are now taken on LMB
- Fixed a bug where it was possible to move while inspecting items
- Improved hints
